hero.eyebrow: Frontend Developer · Da Nang city, Viet Nam
hero.name: Nguyen Thanh Ha Huy
hero.role: Frontend Developer building interfaces that are fast, responsive and accessible
hero.pitch: My core focus has always been the end-user experience. I build robust web products that are highly scalable and easy to maintain. For me, speed, performance, and an intuitive UI/UX are never afterthoughts—they are non-negotiable standards in every line of code.

about.title: Background & approach
about.intro: Although my background is in Telecommunications Engineering, I pivoted early on and have dedicated the last 4+ years to specializing in frontend development. Building web applications for both global and local partners has shaped my engineering approach around three core pillars:

highlights.title: UI & Design Systems
highlights.description: I go beyond merely translating Figma designs into pixel-perfect interfaces. I prioritize UI/UX thinking, actively contribute to Design Systems, and write interactive documentation using Storybook to ensure consistency and scalability. Additionally, I leverage testing frameworks like Jest and React Testing Library to validate components and ensure system stability.

highlights.title: Performance & Optimization
highlights.description: To me, speed is never an afterthought. Maintaining high Core Web Vitals scores, implementing lazy loading, utilizing code splitting, and applying Technical SEO are mandatory standards in every line of code I write, guaranteeing the smoothest possible user experience.

highlights.title: Code Quality & Transparency
highlights.description: Cross-code reviews are a core engineering culture, not just a formality—they are essential for enforcing code conventions and minimizing risks. Alongside this, I proactively integrate AI Agents into my development workflow to automate routine tasks, enhance accuracy, and accelerate feature delivery.
